segments.text: Blue shirt, red bicycle, rolling past the pier
I was posted up right here
You nodded at the waves like
Keep it loose, keep it low
Let it drift, let it go
Fender at the corner calling Mango Sweet
Socks in the sand and the tide
Your laugh hit the air like a hand drum roll
I forgot the list, forgot the bills
Ice, ice, ice cups sweating on the rail by the steps
You said don't think too hard
So I did it not yet
You took my sleeve and spun me once like none of it was left
Keep it loose, keep it low
Let it drift, let it go
If the rain comes down, we stay out in it
If the day runs long, we still move with it
And in my hand, no speech, no show
Heart in the breeze, and the bass moves slow
If the sky turns gray, we don't hold it
We lean right back, let the whole thing spin
You and me, same pace, same morning shoes
Nothing to prove, nothing to lose
Keep it loose, keep it long
Let it rip, let it go
